reason: File 161-1:355 asserts the converse and deletes some coherence data. It contains no question or deferred proof request; the missing-coherence test is ours.
File 161-1:621–636 asserts comparison isomorphisms and gives unexplained group symbols. Absence of definitions or proof is our identification problem, not an authorial question.
File 161-2-01:520–524 states the localization and representable-inclusion characterization as a consequence. No authorial question is present.

File 161-2-04:122–132 asserts evaluation invertibility and gives a canceled proof ending in monogenicity. Our correction of that conclusion is editorial. The actual surrounding property questions remain in problems 28–29.
File 161-2-04:180–184 is headed Th. and asserts both the limit and colimit conclusions. It does not query the bicolimit assertion.
File 161-2-04:171–179 and 219–263 assert changing representability and generator criteria. A truncated parenthetical margin does not establish the broad question previously formulated here.
File 161-2-05:1–77 asserts the pointwise-model facts; file 07:415 supplies a later hypothesis correction. This is a correction history, not an authorial question.
File 161-2-06:41 asserts the essential-point criterion. The actual universe warning at45 is retained as an occurrence of problem48; it does not make the criterion itself a question.
File 161-2-06:408–419 asserts the pseudofield characterization and explicitly says the converse is true and known. The distinct actual field-definition question at421 is retained under problem57.
File 161-2-07:613–618 corrects bijection to application, and646–659 proves the representable case. A correction and a proof are not an open question.
File 161-2-02:174 asserts that the model category can be empty without a degenerate classifier. It is not phrased as a question; the pointless example is our explanatory verification.
